title: trycmd tests fail under forced color env
description: Contributors with CLICOLOR_FORCE=1 or FORCE_COLOR=1 in their environment get trycmd snapshot failures because colored output leaks into the snapshots. Per decision, do not silently scrub the env inside tests; instead detect these variables and print a loud warning that they interfere with trycmd tests. Test: manual/visual; the warning lives in tests/cli_tests.rs.
